name: Breakora
description:
Breakora is a professional-grade, real-time cryptocurrency trading terminal built entirely in React 19 + TypeScript + Vite.
It is designed as a modern, dark-themed dashboard that gives traders deep order-flow visibility and advanced volatility analysis in one clean interface.
Core Features

Main Chart: High-performance HTML5 canvas candlestick chart with zoom/pan, mouse crosshair, and live price scale.
Footprint Tape (sidebar): Live bid/ask volume per price level with automatic aggregation, magnifier lens, and imbalance coloring.
Smart Tape (NuTape): Detects large orders, absorption, and imbalances using dynamic baselines.
Order Book: Live depth-20 with visual total bars and spread display.
Recent Trades: Classic tape with buyer/seller coloring.
Adaptive Phase Squeezer (Breakora Engine): The flagship indicator – combines TTM Squeeze-style volatility grading, dynamic phase tunnel, structure boxes (“The Cage”), interest lines, zero-lag FVGs, and a lightweight ML confidence scorer.
Market Scanner: Algorithmic alerts for volume surges, volatility spikes, and price moves across the top 50 USDT pairs.
Flexible Layout: Full drag-and-drop FlexLayout (save/restore, maximize, reset).
Data Source: 100 % real Binance (spot + perpetual) via WebSocket streams + proxy for historical klines. No fake data.

The app runs locally (or in AI Studio) and is built for speed: 10 k–50 k candles, sub-100 ms updates, canvas rendering, and intelligent caching.
It is already trading-bot ready: all data flows are real-time, settings are persisted, and the architecture supports automated order execution in the future.
